affected_predicate.description: Google Maps visibly obtains a driving-duration result for the Orlando-to-Miami trip.

competing_trace_defects.description: After entering directions, the trajectory repeatedly reopened, retyped, and reselected the Orlando start location rather than proceeding directly through the route fields.
The prefix repeatedly clicked or entered duplicate text in the numbered suggestion interface without executing the search or producing a driving-time result.
Repeated attempts to enter Susan's phone number left the New conversation recipient field visibly empty and never advanced to message composition or sending.

chains.rationale: The reuse target repeats the false premise that the launcher suggestions were unclear, but its action merely skips the Maps sign-in prompt. Maps remains usable and later visibly displays an Orlando-to-Miami driving duration of 3 hr 25 min. No harmful bridge from the reused premise to obtaining that duration is observed; the separate navigation and recipient-entry loops are independently visible defects.

summary: The reused false search-history premise is merely concurrent with skipping Maps sign-in and does not visibly harm the driving-duration subgoal, which is later satisfied by a displayed 3 hr 25 min route. Independent loops are visible in prefix search interaction, Maps route-field entry, and recipient entry.
